decisions: Build one package frame result after final Typed IR normalization, before source/fact arrays move into EmitContext. Use the actual function identity table and qualified inline/caller planning.
Keep preparation fallible through Result<Table,Error>; no empty-plan or scalar sentinel fallback. Read the owned Result through readonly context, proven by the focused managed borrow case.
Canonical checked-context language diagnostics run before prepared-emitter integrity diagnostics. A placement error must remain deferred and never replace a source error.
Only attach and verify final-context metadata first. LLVM slot declarations, allocation selection, per-source-unit lifetime ends, mutable headers and ownership suppression remain the next unit.

CSharp allocates every plan slot at function entry; starts use allocation size, ends preserve source-unit identity and skip terminated blocks. Non-Int consumers and unplanned header allocas retain their existing distinct decisions.
